'''2026 GEMPC Matt Wadden DS Court''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Wadden]] at [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matt Wadden]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]]
